T1.name: Sparse Score-Band Trigger
T1.rationale: Captures sparse pages in the borderline ambiguity zone.

T2.name: JavaScript/SPA Score-Band Trigger
T2.rationale: Targets single-page applications that require JS execution to populate links.

T3.name: Sparse JS/SPA Score-Band Trigger
T3.condition: 0.35 <= S1 <= 0.70 and num_links <= 20 and (num_scripts >= 1 or is_spa_shell_pattern == 1)
T3.rationale: Intersection of sparsity and JS dependency in borderline zone.

T4.name: Narrow Ambiguity Zone Trigger
T4.condition: 0.40 <= S1 <= 0.65 and num_links <= 20 and (num_scripts >= 1 or is_spa_shell_pattern == 1)
T4.rationale: Tightly bounded trigger minimizing rendering overhead.

T5.name: Learned Training-OOF Trigger
T5.rationale: Derived strictly from training partition OOF false-positive cluster.
